texts.preamble: Samim Ahmed S/O Abdul Vahid vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 12 June, 2024 Author: Shivkumar Dige Bench: Shivkumar Dige 2024:Bhc-Aug:10747 1 220.24Aba In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 939 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 220 Of 2024 Samim Ahmed s/o. Abdul Vahid. .. Applicant Versus The State of Maharashtra & another. .. Respondents ... Advocate for Applicant : Mr.Saurabh R. Nikat h/f. Adv.R.R.Karpe App for Respondent-State : Mr.P.K.Lakhotiya ... Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
texts.facts: , the informant Police Constable Shashikant Shauraj Shinde of Naldurga Police Station was on Nakabandi duty at Golai Chowk, Naldurga along with other police personnel and Homeguard. When they were performing their duties, one vehicle of Eicher company bearing No.TS-12/UD-9273 2 220.24ABA Samim Ahmed S/O Abdul Vahid vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169245509/ 1 was found to them. They inquired the name of the driver. He disclosed his name as Shami Ahmed Abdul Vahid Khan, resident of Hajif Peth, Miyapur, Hyderabad [Telangana]. On further inquiry, police found Gutkha Pan Masala in it, which were in Gani bags. They informed it to API Lokhande. He sent API Devkar at the place of incident. He called two panchas. At that time, the applicant ran away by taking advantage of darkness. In all 45 Gani bags containing Goa 1000 Gutkha worth Rs.18,00,000/- was found. It was seized and taken in custody. The seizure of aforesaid Gutkha was informed to Assistant Food Commissioner, Dharashiv. He sent Food Officer Shri S.G.Mandalik for taking further action. He inquired and when he came to know that the driver had ran away, he informed that he is unable to take further action. So, Police Constable Shashikant Shinde lodged the report at Naldurga Police Station.
texts.arguments: 3] It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case. The co-accused, owner of the vehicle, has been released on bail. The police has seized Gutkha. Therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required. The learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the applicant has co-operated the Investigating Officer when he was on interim bail, hence, requested to allow the present application.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3] It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case. The co-accused, owner of the vehicle, has been released on bail. The police has seized Gutkha. Therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required. The learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the applicant has co-operated the Investigating Officer when he was on interim bail, hence, requested to allow the present application.
